_comment: Manifest for selfcheck.py. Each entry records a dependency that no single file states, so a mechanical check can hold it. Update deliberately — see the fix text each check emits.

skills/sync/references/extract-api-promp._why: Fields in this output format are what Step 4B and audit D10 compare. A field added here and nowhere else ships inert — this happened to errors_propagated.

skills/sync/references/audit-doc-repo-pr._why: Phase B's coverage block is only worth emitting if the orchestrator gates on it.

skills/sync/references/deep-chain-prompt._why: 4C's sub-agent payload shape is validated by the orchestrator on both fresh and cached results.

sync-extract-v3._why: Step 2's cache is keyed partly by this tag. Editing the prompt without bumping serves entries built under a different output schema.

sync-deepchain-v2._why: Step 4C's cache tag. Covers the prompt AND 4C.4's guard rules, since a cache hit does not re-run the guards.

_conventional_negative_flags_why: Bare --no-X is normally a smell (it cannot gain values later), but --no-cache is a cross-tool convention (npm, pip, docker, cargo) and renaming it to --cache on|off would be the surprising choice. Allowlist it rather than teaching readers to ignore this check. Add to this list only for genuinely established conventions.
_host_constructs_why: Inventory of host-specific constructs, documented in PORTABILITY.md. Non-zero is fine; growing silently is not. When this check fires, decide whether the construct belongs there at all before adding the file to the list.
